raw_comment: I notice that droughts vary from area to area. In certain regions, there are worse droughts, while in others the drought is to a lesser extent. I wonder what the major factors of these results are. Is it human-made mostly or is most of it due to the environment? This relates to my community because in New York, the drought condition is stated as "abnormally," meaning that the droughts occurring here are abnormal. A catchy headline for this graph could be "Severity of droughts within the United States."
